supporter.title.description: Title of the user's page of the supporter plans, and its entry in the settings menu.

supporter.app.defaultMessage: 此页面在应用中不可用。
supporter.app.description: Shown in the mobile app instead of the supporter plans page.

supporter.disabled.defaultMessage: 此服务器不提供支持者方案。
supporter.disabled.description: Shown when the server offers no supporter plans.

supporter.loading.description: Label of the spinner while the supporter plans load.

supporter.failed.description: Heading when the supporter plans could not load.

supporter.retry.description: Button that loads the supporter plans again.

supporter.return.canceled.defaultMessage: 你已离开付款页面，未产生任何费用。
supporter.return.canceled.description: Shown when the user left the payment page without paying.

supporter.return.confirming.defaultMessage: 正在与支付服务商确认你的付款，这需要几秒钟。
supporter.return.confirming.description: Shown after the payment page returned, while the server waits for the payment provider's confirmation.

supporter.return.started.defaultMessage: 感谢你的支持。你的订阅已确认。
supporter.return.started.description: Shown after the payment page returned and the subscription is confirmed.

supporter.plans.title.description: Heading of the list of supporter plans to choose from.

supporter.plans.description.defaultMessage: 方案用于支持此服务器的运营。较高的方案包含较低方案的全部内容。你一次只能订阅一个方案。

supporter.plans.empty.defaultMessage: 目前没有可订阅的方案。
supporter.plans.empty.description: Shown when no supporter plan takes subscriptions now.

supporter.plans.plan.description: Label of the radio group of the plans.

supporter.plans.interval.description: Label of the radio group of monthly or yearly payment.

supporter.plans.prices.description: The monthly and the yearly prices of a plan. monthly and yearly are amounts per interval.

supporter.per_month.description: An amount paid every month. amount is formatted money.

supporter.per_year.description: An amount paid every year. amount is formatted money.

supporter.ineligible.not_local.defaultMessage: 只有此服务器的用户可以订阅。
supporter.ineligible.not_local.description: Why the user cannot subscribe: the account is not of this server.

supporter.ineligible.email_unverified.defaultMessage: 要订阅，请先通过服务器发送给你的邮件中的链接验证你的电子邮件地址。
supporter.ineligible.email_unverified.description: Why the user cannot subscribe: their primary email address is not verified.

supporter.ineligible.restricted.defaultMessage: 你的账号在已封禁或正在删除期间无法订阅。
supporter.ineligible.restricted.description: Why the user cannot subscribe: the account is suspended or being deleted.

supporter.subscribe.description: Button that opens the final confirmation of a subscription.

supporter.confirm.title.description: Title of the final confirmation before the payment page. plan is the plan's name.

supporter.confirm.description.defaultMessage: 请查看以下条款。你将在支付服务商的页面上输入付款信息，而不是在此服务器上。
supporter.confirm.description.description: Explanation in the final confirmation before the payment page.

supporter.confirm.plan.description: Term: the plan in the final confirmation.

supporter.confirm.amount.description: Term: the amount in the final confirmation.

supporter.confirm.amount.value.description: The amount of the subscription. price is an amount per interval.

supporter.confirm.payments.description: Term: when the payments are made.

supporter.confirm.payments.value.defaultMessage: {interval, select, year {立即付款，之后每年付款} other {立即付款，之后每月付款}}
supporter.confirm.payments.value.description: When the payments of a subscription are made.

supporter.confirm.benefits.value.description: When the benefits of a plan start.

supporter.confirm.cancel.value.defaultMessage: 可随时在此页面取消。权益保留至已付费周期结束，之后不再扣款。
supporter.confirm.cancel.value.description: How to cancel a subscription and what it does.

supporter.confirm.go.description: Button that goes to the payment provider's page.

supporter.confirm.failed.description: Why the payment page could not open.

supporter.commerce.description: Link to the server's page of commerce disclosures.

supporter.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog of the supporter plans without doing anything.

supporter.subscription.plan.description: Term: the plan of the subscription.

supporter.subscription.state.description: Term: the state of the subscription.

supporter.subscription.price.description: Term: what the subscription renews at.

supporter.subscription.ends_at.description: Term: when a cancelled subscription ends.

supporter.subscription.grace_ends_at.description: Term: when a subscription whose payment failed loses its benefits.

supporter.subscription.scheduled.description: Term: a change that waits for the end of the period.

supporter.subscription.scheduled.value.description: The scheduled change. plan is the new plan's name, price an amount per interval, date a formatted date and time.

supporter.state.pending.description: State of a subscription: started, not paid yet.

supporter.state.canceling.description: State of a subscription: cancelled at the end of the period.

supporter.state.past_due.description: State of a subscription: a payment failed recently.

supporter.state.lapsed.description: State of a subscription: a payment failed long ago, the benefits are paused.

supporter.state.abandoned.description: State of a subscription: ended before its first payment.

supporter.note.pending.defaultMessage: 付款尚未完成。请继续前往付款页面完成订阅。
supporter.note.pending.description: Note on a subscription that waits for its first payment.

supporter.note.canceling.defaultMessage: 你的订阅将在周期结束时终止，权益保留至那时。恢复订阅即可继续。

supporter.note.past_due.defaultMessage: 付款失败。请在权益结束前更新你的付款方式。
supporter.note.past_due.description: Note on a subscription whose payment failed recently.

supporter.note.lapsed.defaultMessage: 由于付款逾期，权益已暂停。请更新你的付款方式，或取消订阅。
supporter.note.lapsed.description: Note on a subscription whose payment failed long ago.

supporter.continue_checkout.description: Button that goes to the payment page of a subscription waiting for payment.

supporter.resume.description: Button that withdraws the cancellation of a subscription.

supporter.unschedule.description: Button that withdraws a scheduled change of plan.

supporter.portal.description: Button that opens the payment provider's page of payment methods and invoices.

supporter.portal.failed.defaultMessage: 无法打开付款方式页面：{reason}
supporter.portal.failed.description: Why the payment provider's page could not open.

supporter.command.failed.description: Why a change of the subscription failed.

supporter.cancel_subscription.description: Button that cancels the subscription at the end of the period.

supporter.cancel_subscription.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms cancelling. plan is the plan's name.

supporter.cancel_subscription.descriptio.defaultMessage: 订阅将在已付费周期结束时终止，权益保留至那时，之后不再扣款。你可以在周期结束前恢复订阅。

supporter.keep.description: Button that closes the cancel dialog and keeps the subscription.

supporter.subscription.changed.description: Announced when the plan was changed.

supporter.subscription.canceled.defaultMessage: 订阅将在周期结束时取消。
supporter.subscription.canceled.description: Announced when the subscription was cancelled.

supporter.subscription.resumed.description: Announced when the cancellation was withdrawn.

supporter.subscription.unscheduled.description: Announced when the scheduled change was withdrawn.

supporter.change.title.description: Heading of the section that changes the plan.

supporter.change.description.defaultMessage: 更高的方案或按年付款会在支付本周期剩余时间的差价后生效，差价会立即扣除。更低的方案或按月付款会在周期结束时生效。

supporter.change.price_kept.defaultMessage: 你目前支付的是以前的价格 {price}。更改后，你将支付新方案的当前价格，即使之后改回此方案也是如此。
supporter.change.price_kept.description: Note that a change loses the lower price the user pays now. price is formatted money.

supporter.change.confirm.description: Title of the dialog that confirms a change. plan is the new plan's name.

supporter.change.now.defaultMessage: 本周期剩余时间的差价将立即扣除，付款完成后更改生效。
supporter.change.now.description: A change that applies at once.

supporter.change.period_end.defaultMessage: 更改将在周期结束时生效。在此之前你仍使用当前方案，并且可以撤回更改。
supporter.change.period_end.description: A change that applies at the end of the period.

supporter.change.rules.defaultMessage: 更高的方案或按年付款会在支付立即扣除的差价后生效；更低的方案或按月付款会在周期结束时生效。
supporter.change.rules.description: A change whose timing the page cannot tell.

supporter.change.unchanged.defaultMessage: 请选择其他方案或付款周期以进行更改。
supporter.change.unchanged.description: Why the change button is disabled.

supporter.error.subscribed.defaultMessage: 你已有订阅。请改为更改其方案。
supporter.error.subscribed.description: Problem: the user has a subscription already.

supporter.error.plan_unavailable.defaultMessage: 此方案目前不接受订阅。
supporter.error.plan_unavailable.description: Problem: the plan takes no subscriptions.

supporter.error.state.defaultMessage: 订阅当前的状态不允许此操作。请重新加载页面。
supporter.error.state.description: Problem: the subscription's state does not allow the change.

supporter.error.same_plan.defaultMessage: 这是你当前的方案和付款周期。
supporter.error.same_plan.description: Problem: the change chose the current plan and interval.

supporter.error.payment_failed.defaultMessage: 付款失败，因此你的方案未更改，也未产生任何费用。请更新你的银行卡后重试。每次付款都要求验证的银行卡无法用于支付更改。
supporter.error.payment_failed.description: Problem: the payment of the change failed; the page offers the way to update the card.

supporter.error.payment_processing.defaultMessage: 付款仍在处理中，因此你的方案尚未更改。付款成功后方案即会更改。
supporter.error.payment_processing.description: Problem: the payment of the change has not settled.

supporter.listing.title.description: Heading of the choice to be on the supporter list.

supporter.listing.description.defaultMessage: 支持者名单会在你的方案下显示你的头像、昵称和用户名，不会显示金额或日期。只有本人选择后才会列入名单，你的选择会随订阅结束而失效。
supporter.listing.description.description: What the supporter list shows of the user.

supporter.listing.switch.description: Switch that lists the user on the supporter list.

supporter.listing.listed.description: Announced when the user is listed.

supporter.listing.unlisted.defaultMessage: 你已从支持者名单中移除。
supporter.listing.unlisted.description: Announced when the user is taken off the list.

supporter.listing.failed.description: Why the choice was not saved.
